laps_quali_segment_check.name: laps_quali_segment_check
laps_quali_segment_check.value: quali_segment IS NULL OR quali_segment BETWEEN 1 AND 3

laps_segment_source_check.name: laps_segment_source_check
laps_segment_source_check.value: segment_source IS NULL OR segment_source IN ('window','anchor_repair')

mode2_counterfactual_interval_check.name: mode2_counterfactual_interval_check
mode2_counterfactual_interval_check.value: "mode2_counterfactual"."points_p10" IS NOT NULL AND "mode2_counterfactual"."points_p90" IS NOT NULL AND "mode2_counterfactual"."points_p10" <= "mode2_counterfactual"."points_p90"

mode2_driver_skill_measured_check.name: mode2_driver_skill_measured_check
mode2_driver_skill_measured_check.value:
("mode2_driver_skill"."measured" AND "mode2_driver_skill"."value" IS NOT NULL AND "mode2_driver_skill"."value_lo" IS NOT NULL AND "mode2_driver_skill"."value_hi" IS NOT NULL
      AND "mode2_driver_skill"."not_measured_reason" IS NULL)
 OR (NOT "mode2_driver_skill"."measured" AND "mode2_driver_skill"."value" IS NULL AND "mode2_driver_skill"."not_measured_reason" IS NOT NULL)

quali_results_best_segment_check.name: quali_results_best_segment_check
quali_results_best_segment_check.value: best_segment IS NULL OR best_segment BETWEEN 1 AND 3

quali_results_pole_segment_check.name: quali_results_pole_segment_check
quali_results_pole_segment_check.value: gap_to_pole_segment IS NULL OR gap_to_pole_segment BETWEEN 1 AND 3

quali_teammate_h2h_segment_check.name: quali_teammate_h2h_segment_check
quali_teammate_h2h_segment_check.value: segment IS NULL OR segment BETWEEN 1 AND 3

lap_telemetry_lengths_check.name: lap_telemetry_lengths_check
lap_telemetry_lengths_check.value:
array_length(distance_m,1) = n_samples AND array_length(time_s,1) = n_samples AND
    array_length(x,1) = n_samples AND array_length(y,1) = n_samples AND
    array_length(speed_kph,1) = n_samples AND array_length(brake,1) = n_samples AND
    array_length(throttle_pct,1) = n_samples AND array_length(gear,1) = n_samples AND
    array_length(drs,1) = n_samples
